candidates.name: Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya gas pipeline

evidence.note: Survey work between existing compressor stations in Khanty-Mansi and Tomsk regions; VSG to supply Altai, Kemerovo, Novosibirsk, Tomsk and later Power of Siberia 2; VSG total over 5,000 km. Segment length unknown.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Length unknown. Possible overlap with P0734 (Power of Siberia 2 aka Altai) or P2350/P7615 (Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass); the West Siberian VSG trunk itself is not a roster row. Consolidator to decide. Not strictly cross-border; found while checking the PS-2/Kazakhstan angle.
